Name: Mualani

Source: Reward for inviting Mualani to a duel at The Cat's Tail and claiming victory in a Friendly Fracas with her

12142.Name: Surfshark Wavebreaker
12142.Desc: Attach <color=#FFFFFFFF>$[C112142]</color> to self, enter <color=#FFFFFFFF>$[C112141]</color>, and then gain 2 <color=#FFFFFFFF>"Nightsoul points."</color> (This skill cannot be used after the character enters <color=#FFFFFFFF>$[C112141]</color>)

C112142.Name: Bitey Shark
C112142.Desc: <color=#FFFFFFFF>After both sides switch characters, and $[A1214] is the active character:</color> Spend 1 <color=#FFFFFFFF>Nightsoul point</color> to apply <color=#FFFFFFFF>$[C112143]</color> to the opposing active character.\n$[K58]: $[S3130063]\nWhen the character to which this is attached has 0 <color=#FFFFFFFF>Nightsoul points</color>, discard this card. When this card is discarded, the attached character's <color=#FFFFFFFF>$[C112141]</color> ends.

C112143.Name: Bite Target
C112143.Desc: <color=#FFFFFFFF>When receiving damage dealt by $[A1214] or <color=#FFFFFFFF>$[C112144]</color>:</color> Remove this effect. For each stack, increase the damage by 2.\n(Stacks are accumulative, with no limit.)

C112144.Name: Shark Missile
C112144.Desc: <color=#FFFFFFFF>End Phase:</color> Deal 2 $[K102].\n<color=#FFFFFFFF>$[K3]: 2</color> (Can stack, no stack limit)

K102.Name: {SPRITE_PRESET#2102}<color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro DMG</color>
K102.Desc:
Applies {SPRITE_PRESET#2102}Hydro and can trigger the following Elemental Reactions:
{SPRITE_PRESET#2102}{SPRITE_PRESET#2103}<color=#FFFFFFFF>Vaporize</color>: DMG +2 for this instance
{SPRITE_PRESET#2102}{SPRITE_PRESET#2104}<color=#FFFFFFFF>Electro-Charged</color>：DMG +1 for this instance, deal 1 Piercing DMG to all opposing characters except the target
{SPRITE_PRESET#2102}{SPRITE_PRESET#2101}<color=#FFFFFFFF>Frozen</color>: DMG +1 for this instance, the target is unable to perform any Actions this Round (Can be removed in advance after the target receives +2 Physical or Pyro DMG)
{SPRITE_PRESET#2102}{SPRITE_PRESET#2107}<color=#FFFFFFFF>Bloom</color>: DMG +1 for this instance, creates a [<color=#FFFFFFFF>Dendro Core</color>] that grants +2 DMG to the next instance of Pyro or Electro DMG

K3.Name: <color=#FFFFFFFF>Usage(s)</color>
K3.Desc: After this card's effect is triggered, 1 <color=#FFFFFFFF>Usage</color> of it will be consumed.\nThis card will be discarded immediately once it has 0 <color=#FFFFFFFF>Usages</color> remaining.

K58.Name: <color=#FFFFFFFF>{SPRITE_PRESET#3008}Technique</color>
K58.Desc: When the active character is equipped with a {SPRITE_PRESET#3008}Technique card, they can use the corresponding {SPRITE_PRESET#3008}Technique.\nUsing a {SPRITE_PRESET#3008} Technique counts as a Combat Action. If the character is unable to use Skills due to conditions like Frozen, Petrification, or Stun, they are also unable to use the {SPRITE_PRESET#3008}Technique.\nUsing a {SPRITE_PRESET#3008}Technique is not considered as using a Skill. Therefore, it cannot trigger effects such as "After using a skill" or "After the character triggers an Elemental Reaction." Damage dealt by using a {SPRITE_PRESET#3008}Technique is not considered Damage dealt by the character.
